paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP coupling g_agamma (=1/Lambda) to photons via gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma in PbPb UPC, mass range 5-90 GeV (5e9-9e10 eV). Best limits over 5-50 GeV. However, numerical (mass, g_agamma) pairs are only shown in Fig. 7 and not provided as a table or explicit text values; cross-section limits are 1500-20 nb but coupling values not tabulated. No extractable numerical data points available from text.
